items.question: Trong câu "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", từ "potential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", what does "potential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: potential /pəˈten.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tiềm năng, có thể có. "Potential customers / risks" = khách hàng / rủi ro tiềm năng; danh từ potential = tiềm năng.
items.explanationEn: potential /pəˈten.ʃəl/ (adjective): possible in the future. "Potential customers / risks" are common; as a noun potential means capacity to develop.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", từ "optimum" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", what does "optimum" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: optimum /ˈɒp.tɪ.məm/ (tính từ): tối ưu. "Optimum" = tối ưu, đồng nghĩa optimal; động từ optimise.
items.explanationEn: optimum /ˈɒp.tɪ.məm/ (adjective): best possible. "Optimum" is a synonym of optimal; the verb is optimise.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", từ "resourcing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", what does "resourcing" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resourcing /rɪˈzɔːr.sɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc phân bổ nguồn lực. "Resourcing" = việc bố trí nguồn lực (người, tiền); "resourcing plan" = kế hoạch nhân lực.
items.explanationEn: resourcing /rɪˈzɔːr.sɪŋ/ (noun): supplying people and budget. "Resourcing" means supplying people and money; a "resourcing plan" covers staffing.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", từ "mix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", what does "mix" (noun) mean?
options: tổ hợp, cơ cấu phối hợp
items.explanation: mix /mɪks/ (danh từ): tổ hợp, cơ cấu phối hợp. "Product mix / marketing mix" = cơ cấu sản phẩm / phối thức marketing.
items.explanationEn: mix /mɪks/ (noun): a combination of parts. "Product mix" and "marketing mix" are standard business terms.

items.question: Trong câu "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", từ "overall" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prioritise potential initiatives and understand the optimum resourcing mix and the overall focus of initiatives across the organisation", what does "overall" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overall /ˌoʊ.vərˈɔːl/ (tính từ): tổng thể, chung. "Overall goal / cost" = mục tiêu / chi phí tổng thể; danh từ overalls = quần yếm.
items.explanationEn: overall /ˌoʊ.vərˈɔːl/ (adjective): general, as a whole. "Overall goal / cost" is common; as a noun, overalls are work clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "Provide real-time visibility of the progress of initiatives across the portfolio", từ "visibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Provide real-time visibility of the progress of initiatives across the portfolio", what does "visibility" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng theo dõi, minh bạch
optionsEn: how far one can see outdoors
items.explanation: visibility /ˌvɪz.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng theo dõi, minh bạch. "Give visibility into" = giúp nắm rõ tình hình; nghĩa đen là tầm nhìn (low visibility = tầm nhìn kém).
items.explanationEn: visibility /ˌvɪz.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the ability to see status. "Give visibility into" means make status clear; literally how far you can see.

items.question: Trong câu "Provide real-time visibility of the progress of initiatives across the portfolio", từ "real-time" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Provide real-time visibility of the progress of initiatives across the portfolio", what does "real-time" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: real-time /ˌriːlˈtaɪm/ (tính từ): theo thời gian thực. "Real-time data / dashboard" = dữ liệu / bảng điều khiển thời gian thực.
items.explanationEn: real-time /ˌriːlˈtaɪm/ (adjective): updated as it happens. "Real-time data / dashboard" means updated instantly.

items.question: Trong câu "often used with balanced scorecards and value stream maps to optimise resource allocation", từ "optimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "often used with balanced scorecards and value stream maps to optimise resource allocation", what does "optimise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make the best use of
items.explanation: optimise /ˈɒp.tɪ.maɪz/ (động từ): tối ưu hóa. "Optimise costs / performance" = tối ưu chi phí / hiệu năng; Mỹ viết optimize.
items.explanationEn: optimise /ˈɒp.tɪ.maɪz/ (verb): to make the best use of. "Optimise costs / performance" is common; American spelling is optimize.

items.question: Trong câu "often used with balanced scorecards and value stream maps to optimise resource allocation", từ "allocation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "often used with balanced scorecards and value stream maps to optimise resource allocation", what does "allocation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: allocation /ˌæl.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân bổ. "Resource allocation" = phân bổ nguồn lực; động từ allocate.
items.explanationEn: allocation /ˌæl.əˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): sharing out. "Resource allocation" is a core management term; the verb is allocate.

items.question: Trong câu "Communicate the expected future direction of the product and improve collaboration among teams in different initiatives", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Communicate the expected future direction of the product and improve collaboration among teams in different initiatives", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): truyền đạt, thông báo. "Communicate a vision / change" = truyền đạt tầm nhìn / thay đổi; nghĩa khác là lây (bệnh).
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to share information. "Communicate a vision / change" means share it; for diseases it means pass on.

items.question: Trong câu "Communicate the expected future direction of the product and improve collaboration among teams in different initiatives", từ "direction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Communicate the expected future direction of the product and improve collaboration among teams in different initiatives", what does "direction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: direction /dəˈrek.ʃən/ (danh từ): định hướng, hướng đi. "Strategic direction" = định hướng chiến lược; "directions" (số nhiều) = chỉ đường.
items.explanationEn: direction /dəˈrek.ʃən/ (noun): the course being taken. "Strategic direction" is the course taken; plural directions are route instructions.

items.question: Trong câu "Communicate the expected future direction of the product and improve collaboration among teams in different initiatives", từ "expected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Communicate the expected future direction of the product and improve collaboration among teams in different initiatives", what does "expected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: expected /ɪkˈspek.tɪd/ (tính từ): được dự kiến. "Expected results / benefits" = kết quả / lợi ích dự kiến.
items.explanationEn: expected /ɪkˈspek.tɪd/ (adjective): anticipated. "Expected results / benefits" are common planning phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "in order to prioritise, plan and integrate value creation and waste reduction between initiatives", từ "integrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "in order to prioritise, plan and integrate value creation and waste reduction between initiatives", what does "integrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: integrate /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪt/ (động từ): tích hợp. "Integrate A with / into B" = tích hợp A với / vào B; danh từ integration.
items.explanationEn: integrate /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪt/ (verb): to combine. "Integrate A with / into B" is common; the noun is integration.

items.question: Trong câu "in order to prioritise, plan and integrate value creation and waste reduction between initiatives", từ "in order to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "in order to prioritise, plan and integrate value creation and waste reduction between initiatives", what does "in order to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in order to /ɪn ˈɔːr.dər tuː/ (cụm từ): để, nhằm. "In order to" = để (chỉ mục đích), trang trọng hơn "to".
items.explanationEn: in order to /ɪn ˈɔːr.dər tuː/ (phrase): so as to. "In order to" expresses purpose and is more formal than plain "to".

items.question: Trong câu "in order to prioritise, plan and integrate value creation and waste reduction between initiatives", từ "reduction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "in order to prioritise, plan and integrate value creation and waste reduction between initiatives", what does "reduction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reduction /rɪˈdʌk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cắt giảm. "Cost reduction" = cắt giảm chi phí; động từ reduce.
items.explanationEn: reduction /rɪˈdʌk.ʃən/ (noun): a decrease. "Cost reduction" is common; the verb is reduce.

items.question: Trong câu "Understand the appropriate timeframe in which to make a decision", từ "appropriate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understand the appropriate timeframe in which to make a decision", what does "appropriate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: appropriate /əˈproʊ.pri.ət/ (tính từ): thích hợp. "Appropriate" (tính từ) = thích hợp; động từ appropriate /əˈproʊ.pri.eɪt/ = chiếm dụng.
items.explanationEn: appropriate /əˈproʊ.pri.ət/ (adjective): suitable. "Appropriate" as an adjective means suitable; the verb (pronounced differently) means to take for oneself.

items.question: Trong câu "that is, how long a decision can responsibly be deferred", từ "that is" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "that is, how long a decision can responsibly be deferred", what does "that is" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: that is /ðæt ɪz/ (cụm từ): tức là, nghĩa là. "That is" (viết tắt i.e.) = tức là, dùng để giải thích rõ ý trước.
items.explanationEn: that is /ðæt ɪz/ (phrase): in other words. "That is" (abbreviated i.e.) introduces a clarification.

items.question: Trong câu "that is, how long a decision can responsibly be deferred", từ "responsibly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "that is, how long a decision can responsibly be deferred", what does "responsibly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: responsibly /rɪˈspɒn.sə.bli/ (trạng từ): một cách có trách nhiệm. "Act responsibly" = hành động có trách nhiệm; "last responsible moment" = thời điểm muộn nhất vẫn an toàn để quyết định.
items.explanationEn: responsibly /rɪˈspɒn.sə.bli/ (adverb): in a sensible, accountable way. "Act responsibly" is common; agile talks of the "last responsible moment" to decide.

items.question: Trong câu "that is, how long a decision can responsibly be deferred", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "that is, how long a decision can responsibly be deferred", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): hoãn lại. "Defer a decision" = hoãn quyết định; "defer to someone" = nghe theo ý kiến ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to postpone. "Defer a decision" means postpone it; "defer to someone" means accept their view.

items.question: Trong câu "Plan the allocation of resources across multiple initiatives", từ "multiple" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Plan the allocation of resources across multiple initiatives", what does "multiple" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: multiple /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pəl/ (tính từ): nhiều. "Multiple teams / times" = nhiều nhóm / nhiều lần; danh từ multiple = bội số.
items.explanationEn: multiple /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pəl/ (adjective): many. "Multiple teams / times" means many; as a noun, a multiple is a number in maths.

items.question: Trong câu "they are what separate the four techniques that get swapped most often", từ "separate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they are what separate the four techniques that get swapped most often", what does "separate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to live apart as a couple
items.explanation: separate /ˈsep.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): phân biệt, tách biệt. "Separate A from B" = tách / phân biệt A với B; nghĩa khác là ly thân.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsep.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to tell apart. "Separate A from B" means tell them apart; couples may also separate.

items.question: Trong câu "If the question asks about the timing of a decision, you need not read the other three options.", từ "timing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the question asks about the timing of a decision, you need not read the other three options.", what does "timing" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: timing /ˈtaɪ.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): thời điểm (thực hiện). "Good / bad timing" = đúng / sai thời điểm.
items.explanationEn: timing /ˈtaɪ.mɪŋ/ (noun): when something is done. "Good / bad timing" refers to choosing when to act.

items.question: Trong câu "If the question asks about the timing of a decision, you need not read the other three options.", từ "need not" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the question asks about the timing of a decision, you need not read the other three options.", what does "need not" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: need not /niːd nɒt/ (cụm từ): không cần phải. "Need not do" = không cần làm (trang trọng), khác "must not" = không được làm.
items.explanationEn: need not /niːd nɒt/ (phrase): do not have to. "Need not do" means it is unnecessary; "must not" means it is forbidden.

items.question: Trong câu "A vision statement in an agile context is a concise statement of goals, scope and expected benefits", từ "concise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vision statement in an agile context is a concise statement of goals, scope and expected benefits", what does "concise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn. "Concise" = ngắn gọn mà đủ ý; "clear and concise" là cụm hay dùng.
items.explanationEn: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (adjective): brief and clear. "Clear and concise" is a common pairing.

items.question: Trong câu "A vision statement in an agile context is a concise statement of goals, scope and expected benefits", từ "benefit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vision statement in an agile context is a concise statement of goals, scope and expected benefits", what does "benefit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: benefit /ˈben.ɪ.fɪt/ (danh từ): lợi ích. "Expected benefits" = lợi ích dự kiến; "benefits" còn là trợ cấp (unemployment benefits).
items.explanationEn: benefit /ˈben.ɪ.fɪt/ (noun): an advantage gained. "Expected benefits" are gains; benefits can also mean state payments.

items.question: Trong câu "few words, usually with a visual", từ "visual" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "few words, usually with a visual", what does "visual" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: visual /ˈvɪʒ.u.əl/ (danh từ): hình minh họa. "Visuals" = hình ảnh, biểu đồ minh họa trong bài trình bày.
items.explanationEn: visual /ˈvɪʒ.u.əl/ (noun): a picture or diagram. "Visuals" are the images and charts in a presentation.

items.question: Trong câu "Two familiar distractors are rejected outright", từ "familiar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two familiar distractors are rejected outright", what does "familiar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: familiar /fəˈmɪl.jər/ (tính từ): quen thuộc. "Be familiar with" = quen thuộc với; nghĩa khác là suồng sã (too familiar).
items.explanationEn: familiar /fəˈmɪl.jər/ (adjective): well known. "Be familiar with" means know well; "too familiar" means overly informal.

items.question: Trong câu "Two familiar distractors are rejected outright", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two familiar distractors are rejected outright", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): bác bỏ. "Reject a proposal" = bác bỏ đề xuất; danh từ rejection.
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to turn down. "Reject a proposal" is common; the noun is rejection.

items.question: Trong câu "A formal document with robust descriptions of goals, scope and expected benefits", từ "robust" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A formal document with robust descriptions of goals, scope and expected benefits", what does "robust" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: robust /roʊˈbʌst/ (tính từ): đầy đủ, chi tiết. "Robust" ở đây = đầy đủ, chắc chắn; với người là khỏe mạnh.
items.explanationEn: robust /roʊˈbʌst/ (adjective): thorough and detailed. "Robust" here means thorough; for people it means strong and healthy.

items.question: Trong câu "a dense formal document is not an agile way of working.", từ "dense" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a dense formal document is not an agile way of working.", what does "dense" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dense /dens/ (tính từ): dày đặc, nặng chữ. "Dense text" = văn bản dày đặc khó đọc; "densely populated" = đông dân.
items.explanationEn: dense /dens/ (adjective): packed and heavy to read. "Dense text" is hard to read; "densely populated" means crowded.

items.question: Trong câu "A project charter document to initiate the project", từ "charter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project charter document to initiate the project", what does "charter" (noun) mean?
options: điều lệ, văn bản khởi động
items.explanation: charter /ˈtʃɑːr.tər/ (danh từ): điều lệ, văn bản khởi động. "Project charter" = văn bản khởi động dự án; "charter flight" = chuyến bay thuê bao.
items.explanationEn: charter /ˈtʃɑːr.tər/ (noun): a founding document. "Project charter" authorises a project; a "charter flight" is a hired plane.

items.question: Trong câu "A project charter document to initiate the project", từ "initiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project charter document to initiate the project", what does "initiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/ (động từ): khởi xướng, bắt đầu. "Initiate a project" = khởi động dự án; nghĩa khác là kết nạp thành viên.
items.explanationEn: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/ (verb): to start. "Initiate a project" means start it; it can also mean admit someone to a group.

items.question: Trong câu "it sounds logical, but a charter is left over from older ways of working", từ "logical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it sounds logical, but a charter is left over from older ways of working", what does "logical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: logical /ˈlɒdʒ.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): hợp lý. "It sounds logical" = nghe có vẻ hợp lý; trái nghĩa illogical.
items.explanationEn: logical /ˈlɒdʒ.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): reasonable. "It sounds logical" means reasonable; the opposite is illogical.

items.question: Trong câu "it sounds logical, but a charter is left over from older ways of working", từ "left over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it sounds logical, but a charter is left over from older ways of working", what does "left over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: left over /ˌleft ˈoʊ.vər/ (cụm từ): còn sót lại. "Left over from" = còn sót lại từ; danh từ leftovers = đồ ăn thừa.
items.explanationEn: left over /ˌleft ˈoʊ.vər/ (phrase): remaining. "Left over from" means remaining from; leftovers are uneaten food.

items.question: Trong câu "an entire charter is not needed here.", từ "entire" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an entire charter is not needed here.", what does "entire" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: entire /ɪnˈtaɪər/ (tính từ): toàn bộ. "The entire team" = cả đội; trạng từ entirely.
items.explanationEn: entire /ɪnˈtaɪər/ (adjective): whole. "The entire team" means the whole team; the adverb is entirely.

items.question: Trong câu "must have a baseline and a goal value.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "must have a baseline and a goal value.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): mức cơ sở ban đầu. "Baseline" = mốc so sánh ban đầu; trong tennis là đường biên cuối sân.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): a starting reference. "Baseline" is the starting point for comparison; in tennis it is the back line.

items.question: Trong câu "Increase the number of purchases per customer", từ "purchase" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Increase the number of purchases per customer", what does "purchase" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: purchase /ˈpɜːr.tʃəs/ (danh từ): lần mua hàng. "Make a purchase" = mua hàng; "purchase order" = đơn đặt hàng.
items.explanationEn: purchase /ˈpɜːr.tʃəs/ (noun): an act of buying. "Make a purchase" and "purchase order" are common business phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "describes a change in customer behaviour", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "describes a change in customer behaviour", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪ.vjər/ (danh từ): hành vi. "Customer behaviour" = hành vi khách hàng; Mỹ viết behavior.
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪ.vjər/ (noun): the way someone acts. "Customer behaviour" is a marketing term; American spelling is behavior.

items.question: Trong câu "Create loyalty and repeat visitors", từ "loyalty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create loyalty and repeat visitors", what does "loyalty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: loyalty /ˈlɔɪ.əl.ti/ (danh từ): sự trung thành. "Customer loyalty" = lòng trung thành của khách hàng; "loyalty programme" = chương trình khách hàng thân thiết.
items.explanationEn: loyalty /ˈlɔɪ.əl.ti/ (noun): faithfulness. "Customer loyalty" and "loyalty programme" are common marketing terms.

items.question: Trong câu "Implement an upgrade to the software", từ "upgrade" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Implement an upgrade to the software", what does "upgrade" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: upgrade /ˈʌp.ɡreɪd/ (danh từ): bản nâng cấp. "Software upgrade" = nâng cấp phần mềm; "get an upgrade" còn là được nâng hạng (vé, phòng).
items.explanationEn: upgrade /ˈʌp.ɡreɪd/ (noun): an improved version. "Software upgrade" is common; travellers also "get an upgrade" to a better seat or room.

items.question: Trong câu "Kano analysis looks at which product characteristics will act as a differentiator and drive customer satisfaction", từ "characteristic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano analysis looks at which product characteristics will act as a differentiator and drive customer satisfaction", what does "characteristic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: characteristic /ˌkær.ək.təˈrɪs.tɪk/ (danh từ): đặc điểm. "Key characteristics" = đặc điểm chính; khác character = nhân vật / tính cách.
items.explanationEn: characteristic /ˌkær.ək.təˈrɪs.tɪk/ (noun): a typical feature. "Key characteristics" are typical features; compare character (a person in a story).

items.question: Trong câu "Kano analysis looks at which product characteristics will act as a differentiator and drive customer satisfaction", từ "differentiator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kano analysis looks at which product characteristics will act as a differentiator and drive customer satisfaction", what does "differentiator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: differentiator /ˌdɪf.əˈren.ʃi.eɪ.tər/ (danh từ): yếu tố tạo khác biệt. "Key differentiator" = yếu tố khác biệt chính so với đối thủ.
items.explanationEn: differentiator /ˌdɪf.əˈren.ʃi.eɪ.tər/ (noun): what sets a product apart. "Key differentiator" is what makes you stand out from competitors.

items.question: Trong câu "so that effort is not wasted on features that do not move satisfaction.", từ "satisfaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so that effort is not wasted on features that do not move satisfaction.", what does "satisfaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: satisfaction /ˌsæt.ɪsˈfæk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hài lòng. "Customer satisfaction" = sự hài lòng của khách hàng; tính từ satisfied.
items.explanationEn: satisfaction /ˌsæt.ɪsˈfæk.ʃən/ (noun): contentment. "Customer satisfaction" is a key metric; the adjective is satisfied.

items.question: Trong câu "If a question carries all three cues", từ "cue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a question carries all three cues", what does "cue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cue /kjuː/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu gợi ý. "Take your cue from" = làm theo gợi ý của; đồng âm với queue (hàng đợi).
items.explanationEn: cue /kjuː/ (noun): a signal or hint. "Take your cue from" means follow a signal; it sounds the same as queue.

items.question: Trong câu "An impact map is a lightweight visual that breaks organisational goals down into specific deliverables", từ "lightweight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An impact map is a lightweight visual that breaks organisational goals down into specific deliverables", what does "lightweight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lightweight /ˈlaɪt.weɪt/ (tính từ): gọn nhẹ, đơn giản. "Lightweight process" = quy trình gọn nhẹ; trong quyền anh là hạng nhẹ.
items.explanationEn: lightweight /ˈlaɪt.weɪt/ (adjective): simple and low-effort. "Lightweight process" means simple; in boxing it is a weight class.

items.question: Trong câu "An impact map is a lightweight visual that breaks organisational goals down into specific deliverables", từ "break down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An impact map is a lightweight visual that breaks organisational goals down into specific deliverables", what does "break down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ, phân rã. "Break down a goal" = chia nhỏ mục tiêu; "the car broke down" = xe bị hỏng.
items.explanationEn: break down /breɪk daʊn/ (phrase): to split into parts. "Break down a goal" means split it; "the car broke down" means it stopped working.

items.question: Trong câu "An impact map is a lightweight visual that breaks organisational goals down into specific deliverables", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An impact map is a lightweight visual that breaks organisational goals down into specific deliverables", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm bàn giao. "Key deliverables" = các sản phẩm bàn giao chính của dự án.
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output to hand over. "Key deliverables" are the main outputs a project hands over.

items.question: Trong câu "keeping stakeholders focused on the WHY rather than just the features.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "keeping stakeholders focused on the WHY rather than just the features.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈræð.ər ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "A rather than B" = A thay vì B.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈræð.ər ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. "A rather than B" means A instead of B.

items.question: Trong câu "The familiar distractors are real agile nouns in the wrong combination", từ "combination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The familiar distractors are real agile nouns in the wrong combination", what does "combination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: combination /ˌkɒm.bɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự kết hợp. "In combination with" = kết hợp với; nghĩa khác là mã số của khóa.
items.explanationEn: combination /ˌkɒm.bɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a joining together. "In combination with" means together with; it also means a lock code.

items.question: Trong câu "The same family contains one wholly invented name", từ "wholly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same family contains one wholly invented name", what does "wholly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: wholly /ˈhoʊl.li/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn. "Wholly owned subsidiary" = công ty con sở hữu toàn bộ; đừng nhầm với holy (thánh).
items.explanationEn: wholly /ˈhoʊl.li/ (adverb): completely. "Wholly owned subsidiary" is a business term; do not confuse wholly with holy.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", từ "relative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", what does "relative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): tương đối. "Relative to" = so với; danh từ relative = họ hàng.
items.explanationEn: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): by comparison. "Relative to" means compared with; as a noun a relative is a family member.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", từ "collaborative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", what does "collaborative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính hợp tác. "Collaborative approach" = cách làm hợp tác; động từ collaborate.
items.explanationEn: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): done by working together. "Collaborative approach" is common; the verb is collaborate.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", từ "dialogue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", what does "dialogue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dialogue /ˈdaɪ.ə.lɒɡ/ (danh từ): cuộc trao đổi. "Open a dialogue with" = mở cuộc đối thoại với; nghĩa khác là lời thoại trong phim.
items.explanationEn: dialogue /ˈdaɪ.ə.lɒɡ/ (noun): an exchange of views. "Open a dialogue with" means start talks; it also means lines in a film.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", từ "historical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", what does "historical" (adjective) mean?
options: mang tính lịch sử trọng đại
items.explanation: historical /hɪˈstɒr.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): từ quá khứ, trước đây. "Historical data" = dữ liệu quá khứ; khác historic = mang tính lịch sử trọng đại.
items.explanationEn: historical /hɪˈstɒr.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): from past records. "Historical data" is past data; historic means important in history.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Make assumptions" = đưa ra giả định; nghĩa khác: sự đảm nhận (assumption of power).
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something taken as true. "Make assumptions" is common; it can also mean taking on power or a role.

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", từ "critical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimating is a collaborative technique in which dialogue about knowledge, historical experience and assumptions is critical.", what does "critical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: critical /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): cực kỳ quan trọng. "Critical to success" = then chốt cho thành công; nghĩa khác là hay chỉ trích.
items.explanationEn: critical /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): extremely important. "Critical to success" means vital; it can also mean fault-finding.

items.question: Trong câu "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", từ "practically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", what does "practically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: practically /ˈpræk.tɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): trên thực tế. "Practically" có hai nghĩa: trên thực tế (như ở đây) và gần như (practically finished).
items.explanationEn: practically /ˈpræk.tɪ.kli/ (adverb): in practice. "Practically" means in practice (here) or almost (practically finished).

items.question: Trong câu "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", từ "order of magnitude" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", what does "order of magnitude" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: order of magnitude /ˈɔːr.dər əv ˈmæɡ.nɪ.tuːd/ (cụm từ): cấp độ lớn (cỡ ước lượng). "Order of magnitude" = cấp độ lớn, thường gấp 10 lần; "an order of magnitude faster" = nhanh hơn cỡ 10 lần.
items.explanationEn: order of magnitude /ˈɔːr.dər əv ˈmæɡ.nɪ.tuːd/ (phrase): a rough scale of size. "Order of magnitude" is a rough size class; "an order of magnitude faster" means about ten times.

items.question: Trong câu "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", từ "comparison" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", what does "comparison" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: comparison /kəmˈpær.ɪ.sən/ (danh từ): sự so sánh. "In comparison with" = so với; động từ compare.
items.explanationEn: comparison /kəmˈpær.ɪ.sən/ (noun): weighing up side by side. "In comparison with" means compared to; the verb is compare.

items.question: Trong câu "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", từ "previously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", what does "previously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: previously /ˈpriː.vi.əs.li/ (trạng từ): trước đây. "As previously mentioned" = như đã đề cập trước đó.
items.explanationEn: previously /ˈpriː.vi.əs.li/ (adverb): before now. "As previously mentioned" is a common written phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", từ "judge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", what does "judge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (động từ): ước đoán, đánh giá. "Judge how long / how much" = ước đoán bao lâu / bao nhiêu; nghĩa khác là xét xử.
items.explanationEn: judge /dʒʌdʒ/ (verb): to estimate or assess. "Judge how long" means estimate; in court a judge decides cases.

items.question: Trong câu "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", từ "likely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practically, it uses order of magnitude and comparison of an item to previously delivered items to judge how long the item will likely take.", what does "likely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: likely /ˈlaɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): có khả năng, chắc là. "Will likely" = có lẽ sẽ; thường gặp dạng tính từ "be likely to".
items.explanationEn: likely /ˈlaɪ.kli/ (adverb): probably. "Will likely" means probably will; the adjective form is "be likely to".

items.question: Trong câu "Four misreadings are explicitly rejected", từ "misreading" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four misreadings are explicitly rejected", what does "misreading" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriː.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): cách hiểu sai. Tiền tố mis- = sai: misreading, misunderstanding, misuse.
items.explanationEn: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriː.dɪŋ/ (noun): a wrong interpretation. The prefix mis- means wrongly: misreading, misunderstanding, misuse.

items.question: Trong câu "Four misreadings are explicitly rejected", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four misreadings are explicitly rejected", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng. "Explicitly state" = nêu rõ; trái nghĩa implicitly (ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Explicitly state" means say clearly; the opposite is implicitly.

items.question: Trong câu "no calculation produces the number.", từ "calculation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "no calculation produces the number.", what does "calculation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: calculation /ˌkæl.kjəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): phép tính. "Do a calculation" = làm phép tính; động từ calculate.
items.explanationEn: calculation /ˌkæl.kjəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a sum worked out. "Do a calculation" is common; the verb is calculate.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not a tool that generates a Fibonacci number from a user story.", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not a tool that generates a Fibonacci number from a user story.", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra. "Generate revenue / leads" = tạo doanh thu / khách hàng tiềm năng.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to produce. "Generate revenue / leads" are common business collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not something the BA and Scrum Master do on the team's behalf for leadership.", từ "on behalf of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not something the BA and Scrum Master do on the team's behalf for leadership.", what does "on behalf of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhæf əv/ (cụm từ): thay mặt cho. "On behalf of" / "on someone's behalf" = thay mặt ai; hay dùng trong email: "on behalf of the team".
items.explanationEn: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhæf əv/ (phrase): representing, instead of. "On behalf of" / "on someone's behalf" means representing them, as in "on behalf of the team".

items.question: Trong câu ""the team's best guess based on experience" is too thin", từ "thin" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""the team's best guess based on experience" is too thin", what does "thin" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: thin /θɪn/ (tính từ): sơ sài, thiếu nội dung. "A thin argument" = lập luận sơ sài; nghĩa đen là mỏng, gầy.
items.explanationEn: thin /θɪn/ (adjective): too weak. "A thin argument" lacks substance; literally thin means slim.

items.question: Trong câu "it misses both the comparison and the order-of-magnitude aspects.", từ "aspect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it misses both the comparison and the order-of-magnitude aspects.", what does "aspect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: aspect /ˈæs.pekt/ (danh từ): khía cạnh. "Every aspect of" = mọi khía cạnh của.
items.explanationEn: aspect /ˈæs.pekt/ (noun): a part or feature. "Every aspect of" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "it happens ongoing and multiple times throughout the initiative", từ "throughout" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it happens ongoing and multiple times throughout the initiative", what does "throughout" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: throughout /θruːˈaʊt/ (giới từ): trong suốt. "Throughout the project / year" = suốt dự án / cả năm.
items.explanationEn: throughout /θruːˈaʊt/ (preposition): all through. "Throughout the project / year" means during all of it.

items.question: Trong câu "not once at project initiation", từ "initiation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "not once at project initiation", what does "initiation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: initiation /ɪˌnɪʃ.iˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): giai đoạn khởi động. "Project initiation" = khởi động dự án; nghĩa khác là lễ kết nạp.
items.explanationEn: initiation /ɪˌnɪʃ.iˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the start-up stage. "Project initiation" is the start-up stage; it can also mean an admission ritual.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement is also the key input to a planning workshop.", từ "input" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement is also the key input to a planning workshop.", what does "input" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: what comes out of a process
items.explanation: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (danh từ): đầu vào. "Key input to" = đầu vào chính cho; "thanks for your input" = cảm ơn ý kiến đóng góp.
items.explanationEn: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (noun): what goes into a process. "Key input to" is what feeds a process; "thanks for your input" means thanks for your ideas.

items.question: Trong câu "How do you know an implemented increment of a new value stream map is effective?", từ "increment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How do you know an implemented increment of a new value stream map is effective?", what does "increment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (danh từ): phần bổ sung thêm. "Product increment" = phần sản phẩm bổ sung sau mỗi sprint; "salary increment" = khoản tăng lương.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (noun): an added piece. "Product increment" is what a sprint adds; a "salary increment" is a pay rise.

items.question: Trong câu "How do you know an implemented increment of a new value stream map is effective?", từ "effective" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How do you know an implemented increment of a new value stream map is effective?", what does "effective" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: effective /ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (tính từ): hiệu quả. "Effective" = hiệu quả; "effective from 1 May" = có hiệu lực từ 1/5.
items.explanationEn: effective /ɪˈfek.tɪv/ (adjective): working well. "Effective" means working well; "effective from 1 May" means in force from that date.

items.question: Trong câu "Reporting the milestones met — also an output measure.", từ "milestone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reporting the milestones met — also an output measure.", what does "milestone" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stoʊn/ (danh từ): cột mốc. "Meet / hit a milestone" = đạt cột mốc; nghĩa đen là cột cây số.
items.explanationEn: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stoʊn/ (noun): a key project checkpoint. "Meet / hit a milestone" means reach a checkpoint; literally a roadside marker.

items.question: Trong câu "customer opinion matters, but only alongside measures aligned to value, never on its own.", từ "opinion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "customer opinion matters, but only alongside measures aligned to value, never on its own.", what does "opinion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: opinion /əˈpɪn.jən/ (danh từ): ý kiến, quan điểm. "In my opinion" = theo ý tôi; "second opinion" = ý kiến thứ hai.
items.explanationEn: opinion /əˈpɪn.jən/ (noun): a personal view. "In my opinion" and "a second opinion" are everyday phrases.

items.question: Trong câu "customer opinion matters, but only alongside measures aligned to value, never on its own.", từ "alongside" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "customer opinion matters, but only alongside measures aligned to value, never on its own.", what does "alongside" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: alongside /əˌlɔːŋˈsaɪd/ (giới từ): cùng với. "Work alongside" = làm việc cùng; nghĩa đen là dọc bên cạnh.
items.explanationEn: alongside /əˌlɔːŋˈsaɪd/ (preposition): together with. "Work alongside" means work together with; literally beside.

items.question: Trong câu "customer opinion matters, but only alongside measures aligned to value, never on its own.", từ "on its own" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "customer opinion matters, but only alongside measures aligned to value, never on its own.", what does "on its own" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on its own /ɒn ɪts oʊn/ (cụm từ): tự nó, riêng lẻ. "On its own" = riêng nó, không kèm gì khác; "on my own" = một mình.
items.explanationEn: on its own /ɒn ɪts oʊn/ (phrase): by itself alone. "On its own" means alone; "on my own" means by myself.

items.question: Trong câu "Learn the distinctive phrase", từ "distinctive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn the distinctive phrase", what does "distinctive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinctive /dɪˈstɪŋk.tɪv/ (tính từ): đặc trưng. "Distinctive feature" = đặc điểm riêng biệt, dễ nhận ra.
items.explanationEn: distinctive /dɪˈstɪŋk.tɪv/ (adjective): easy to tell apart. "Distinctive feature" is one that makes something easy to recognise.

items.question: Trong câu "A vision statement is concise on goals, scope, benefits.", từ "concise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vision statement is concise on goals, scope, benefits.", what does "concise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn. "Keep it concise" = viết ngắn gọn thôi.
items.explanationEn: concise /kənˈsaɪs/ (adjective): brief. "Keep it concise" is common writing advice.

items.question: Trong câu "A project charter is left over from older ways of working.", từ "left over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project charter is left over from older ways of working.", what does "left over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: left over /ˌleft ˈoʊ.vər/ (cụm từ): còn sót lại. "Left over from" = còn lại từ (thời trước).
items.explanationEn: left over /ˌleft ˈoʊ.vər/ (phrase): remaining. "Left over from" means still remaining from an earlier time.

items.question: Trong câu ""Business value map" is an invented name.", từ "invented" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Business value map" is an invented name.", what does "invented" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invented /ɪnˈven.tɪd/ (tính từ): bịa ra. "An invented name / story" = tên / câu chuyện bịa ra.
items.explanationEn: invented /ɪnˈven.tɪd/ (adjective): made up. "An invented name / story" is one that is made up.

items.question: Trong câu "Initiative-horizon backlog refinement is continuous", từ "continuous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Initiative-horizon backlog refinement is continuous", what does "continuous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (tính từ): liên tục. "Continuous improvement" = cải tiến liên tục; khác continual (lặp đi lặp lại có ngắt quãng).
items.explanationEn: continuous /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs/ (adjective): ongoing. "Continuous improvement" is a Lean term; continual means repeated with breaks.
